concept.title: Carer status
concept.shortdesc: Conditions about being a carer or receiving care, including registering as a carer or staying with the person being cared for.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Being an unpaid carer for someone who needs help, or receiving paid or unpaid care yourself.
: Conditions about a carer, such as having to be a carer, being registered with a carers' service, or a carer or parent having to stay with the person at sessions.
: Conditions about where and how a person lives or whether they can get out, such as living alone, being housebound, owning or renting, or not being homeless.
